_doc: W6-B FULL DISTRICT spec — replaces D10's hand-stamped exterior with a compiler-generated fragment covering the district's ENTIRE bbox. bbox CORRECTED to the district's real footprint: the hand file declares bbox {4200,200,1900,1400} but every one of its own patches/stamps actually sits at x:[2680,3872] y:[160,1040] (EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md #4 — camping's declared bbox is stale/oversized after a relocate). This spec uses the true, tile-snapped footprint {2672,160,1200,880} so the compiled ground lines up with the hand fragment's own patches/roads/solids that scripts/merge-city-plan.py --compiler-replaces keeps. Verified clear of the existing d19-wild-camp-pocket generated district (4320,304,480,480 — x-disjoint, starts at 4320 > our x1=3872). Compile with: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/full/d10-wild.json --qa -v.
